newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian president asserts Syria's determination to achieve just and comprehensive Middle East peace.
- Egypt says Saddam approves of its role in northern Iraq.
- Kuwaiti government discusses with economic officials the new rise in share prices.
- Jordanian crown prince opens a Jordanian-Japanese cement plant at a cost of $85 million.
- U.S official says Saudi Arabia has not allowed Washington to question those arrested in relation to al-Khobar bombing last June which killed 19 Americans.
- Around 24 Turkish officers visit Israel to boost ties.
- Emirates Airlines signs a $138 million loan to finance purchase of a new plane.
